Anna Zhou: Heads-up: Vega + Orion are asking for a BYO-network, low-touch on-prem flow (VPC peering + customer-managed BGP + egress IP preservation). Theyre ok as beta participants. Can we scope an operator-shim (minimal footprint) for Q2?
Priya Nair: If they're paying, we should. List must include: CIDR overlap checks, explicit egress-preserve UX, migration playbook (dry-run), rollback procedure, one NetOps run with their team. Also need an SLO/exception doc.
Miguel Santos: Tech constraints: shim will be a sidecar/control-plane split. Plan A: shim only (no change to customer routing), Plan B: full bundle later for in-place upgrades. Need flags: `--egress-prefix`, `--snat=preserve|force`, and a health endpoint that reports BGP session status.
Noor Patel: UX proposal (CLI-first): `redwood install --mode=byo-network --egress-prefix 198.51.100.0/29 --preserve-egress=true` -> validator runs CIDR overlap + NAT detection, prints summary, requires `--confirm`. Add `audit.log` entry.
Sam O'Connor: Canary/test plan: 2 tenants on identical infra, 72h soak, inject BGP flap, validate fallback to hosted fallback model for N minutes, measure 99p latency and tail token issuance time. Also verify KMS key rotation during upgrade window. Maintenance window: customers prefer <=3h.
Priya Nair: Launch gates (draft): 1) Field sign-off from both customers; 2) Installer performs preflight checks; 3) Migration dry-run + rollback tested; 4) Documentation: install, network runbook, known limitations; 5) Billing & support tagging (beta label); 6) Console flag for fallback policy.
Miguel Santos: Risk notes: overlapping CIDRs require SNAT which breaks upstream ACLs; must document tradeoffs and include `egress-preserve` best-effort wording. Also need an automated IP claim/release flow for `egress-prefix`.
DevDeployBot: CI: feat/byo-network branch -> installer smoke 5/6 green, integration with BGP sim failed (retry queued).
Noor Patel: Edge UX: support `--dry-run` output that prints: "PRECHECK OK" or lists conflicts with recommended fixes. Example message: `Conflict: CIDR overlap 10.0.0.0/16 vs customer-provided 10.0.0.0/24. Recommend route-remap or specify --egress-prefix <public>`.
Sam O'Connor: Ops checklist for handoff: runbook owner (Noor), field demo + playbook (Priya), engineering rollback steps (Miguel). Schedule 30m run with FieldOps next Tue.
Anna Zhou: Good. Action items: Noor/Priya/Miguel to produce 1-pager with gates + migration playbook by Thu EOD. Sam to schedule FieldOps demo. I'll queue this for sprint planning. :rocket:
